cards.title: Who can do this
items: Personal token and app consent: the owner, signed in as themselves, not while impersonating
Admins and members see an owner-only note on MCP; a founder viewing sees the apps and may disconnect them
Help, support, votes and suggestions: any signed-in person; /api/support is a public route

cards.title: Refusals and limits
items: Support: 10 an hour per IP; votes: 60 an hour per account; suggestions: 5 a day per account
OAuth needs the exact registered redirect_uri, response_type=code and S256 PKCE; codes last 10 minutes, single use
Revoke cuts off only the personal token (OAuth grants untouched); a new token revokes the old one; apps are cut off by Disconnect or a password change or reset

MCP tool calls need a valid token or grant; unknown tools are refused; ask_noor is refused when the trial has ended, a chat rate limit is hit or the account's monthly chat messages are used up (unless continue on credits is on and the balance covers the most one message can cost); save_draft has an hourly limit; when not paused, an ended trial, the agent's monthly cap or too few credits is a tool error for generate_content

cards.title: While the model is paused
items: Model calls are paused since 2026-09-28 (CLAUDE_PAUSED in src/lib/model.ts; a production deploy with no key is paused too)
ask_noor: 'The agents are paused for now, so I can't reply or create content yet. No credits were used.' The chat message it reserved is given back
generate_content: 'Content generation is paused for now. No credits were used.'
Free tools still work: brand rules and checks, drafts, inbox and file reads, to-dos

Normally ask_noor answers like the web chat, counted in the plan's monthly chat messages (4,000 characters at most), and generate_content charges TASK_COST credits (weekly_plan 2, weekly_report 3, followup_seq 4) and adds inbox items
